parsed.text: Panel p0 summarizes location distributions for red and blue across four addressed nodes. Current (completed_record, represented_time 12) distributions: nodes n0, n2 and n3 are uniform 4×4 for both roles; node n1 concentrates blue at cell [1,0] and red at cell [0,2]. Candidate conditional records (native or inherited, represented_time 13) are conditional estimates, not executed events. Across commands: k0 matches current except n0 remains uniform; k1 shifts n0 toward a top-right 2×2 peak for blue and top-left 2×2 peak for red while n1 matches the concentrated cells; k2 places n0 blue at [0,2] and red at [0,0], with n1 again concentrated. Nodes n2 and n3 remain uniformly distributed in current and in all provided conditional records.
